note: Publication gate of the English bank. A question is written to lib/learn/content/bank/english-draft.json (the file the runtime imports) only if its learning item is in 'reviewed' (independent AI review under the strict protocol) or its id is in 'carryOverQuestions' (the 4,031 questions that were already live in the 2026-10-15 release, review pending). Everything else goes to english-pending.json (not loaded). Only 'reviewed' items count as independently reviewed.
